overall_design: Single cells were prepared from human liver biopsies from NAFLD patiehts. Kupffer cells were FAC-sorted by CD14+ and treated with 500nM DPI for 24hrs.  RNA was isolated and purified by Qiagen Rneasy micro kit and applied to RNAseq
summary: To investigate the human primary Kupffer cells from NAFLD patients response to DPI in vitro.
title: Activation of GPR3-b-Arrestin2-PKM2 by DPI enhanced glycolysis in kupffer cells [Human KC]
type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
